description: Resilinc is a commercial supply chain risk platform whose EventWatchAI service monitors more than 100 million news and data sources a month in 100 languages across 200 countries to detect disruptions such as disasters, fires, strikes and regulatory events, and whose multi-tier mapping tool records supplier networks down to the part and site level with supplier-validated data. The company reports more than 500,000 suppliers mapped across tiers and over 100 million validated sites, and adds AI agents for detecting and managing risks and for compliance on tariffs, forced labour and the EU deforestation regulation. It is produced by Resilinc. Coverage is global. The platform is a cloud service sold commercially; no prices are published and demonstrations are arranged on request. Caveats: the maps and alerts are proprietary to subscribers, and the counts are vendor claims from the home page. For simulation it provides predictive disruption alerts, impact modelling and what-if scenario simulation of supplier networks, showing how a hazard at one site cascades through tiers to manufacturers, which makes it a reference tool for supply chain resilience and emergency response planning. It is related to the Open Supply Hub record in this catalogue, an open map of facilities in similar supply chains.
